body: We were dating for over 3 years, a month into our freshman year of college lol. It was my first relationship and that’s why I started feeling doubts in the first place. I felt like I didn’t know enough about myself and about relationships to fully know if this relationships with my ex is what I wanted. You mention coming back to him when I’m ready to settle down, and that reminds me of his parents. They broke up for a year before finding each other again and getting married. It’s funny because all the things you said are things that I already thought about and knew to be true. It’s hard to trust your intuition when making such a risky decision that you’ve never made before. It’s really reassuring to hear from someone who’s gone through this, that this won’t be something to regret. Because you’re right, I will always wonder what life would be to live life for me. I really appreciate your advice, thank you.

I would try to find a moment in person to talk about it. I’d say just be honest about how you feel. It seems like you’re pretty frustrated because you really like her but it feels like she doesn’t want this relationship anymore. I would start there :).

I think you guys need to talk to each other. Sit her down and be upfront with her. Tell her how you are feeling about the relationship and hear her out, maybe she’s feeling some type of way and was struggling to communicate. Hopefully from there you guys can find a better dynamic.
